outcome: Presence of SARS-CoV-2 virus RNA in peritoneal fluid
Presence of SARS-CoV-2 virus RNA in vaginal samples
cohort: The study included 113 patients undergoing abdominal surgery or instrumentation of the lower genital tract.
finding: The presence of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in the abdominal fluid or lower genital tract of presumed COVID-19 negative patients undergoing surgery is nil or extremely low.
cross-section timing: At the time of abdominal surgery or instrumentation of the lower genital tract
